channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Aug 18
item.description:
62 development commits

NPC & AI Fixes

  • Fixed scientists not spawning in underwater labs, cargo ships, and military bases, and corrected cargo scientists movement.
  • Fixed Scientist2 crouch‑walk angle on the Oilrig and old scientists steering behavior (they now turn instantly).
  • Fixed static chairs on the gas station roof now being mountable.

Vehicle & Siege Fixes

  • Fixed catapult ammo pooling, horse pooling, and siege weapon reset issues (all now work reliably).
  • Fixed vehicle seat pooling bugs: seats retain the correct owner, reset properly, and heli rotor speed is restored on init.

Animal & Livestock Updates

  • Added new livestock species (cows and sheep) with gender‑specific models.
  • Fixed animals moving while sleeping and added a sleeping animation for sheep.

Monument & Map Adjustments

  • Adjusted resource rates and melee kill times on monument blockers for consistency.
  • Updated animal fencing system with new gate behavior and removed the hold‑to‑place requirement.

Weapon & Item Fixes

  • Fixed honey bandage healing effect.
  • Fixed third‑person weapon offset so weapons align correctly with the player’s hand.
  • Updated machete animation for smoother use.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Aug 17
item.description:
48 development commits

Gameplay & Item Fixes

  • Fixed livestock animals being forced female and added proper breeding states, including a new bull prefab, so animal breeding now works as intended.
  • Medical honey bandage effects now fire correctly, restoring its healing functionality.
  • Water bucket UI bug resolved – you can now transfer water into a held bucket again.
  • MaxPlayers count is now displayed accurately after recent changes.

Nexus & Server UI

  • Nexus map UI issues fixed: the connect‑modal map button now enables correctly and the map no longer appears squished.
  • Servers with Nexus enabled are now tagged (nexuszone) and hidden from the public server list by default, with Nexus info exposed in A2S rules responses.

Visual & Interface Improvements

  • Underwater Labs windows refraction texture corrected, improving visibility inside the labs.
  • Crosshair null‑reference errors fixed, eliminating occasional crosshair‑related crashes.
  • Added a new white “boomer” firework variant (item, mortar, shell, icon, and particle effect).
